steps.title: Open Cockpit homepage
steps.narration: We start on the Cockpit page, the main trading dashboard showing live tape and market data.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page is fully loaded with no error messages, and the top navigation bar is visible.

steps.title: Navigate to Desk page
steps.narration: Click the Desk link in the top navigation to see the playbook signals and desk features.
steps.point_out: The page navigates to /desk and the Desk nav link is now highlighted as active.

steps.title: Desk page loads with all sections
steps.narration: The Desk page is now fully loaded, showing the main heading and all sections including Playbook Signals, Backscan, and Evidence.
steps.point_out: The Desk heading is visible at the top of the page with no errors, and all section headings are present in order.

steps.title: Enter session date to load playbook signals
steps.narration: We enter the session date 2026-06-22 in the date input field to load the recorded trading signals for that day.
steps.point_out: The date input field now contains the date 2026-06-22.

steps.title: Playbook Signals table shows Range Trade signal
steps.narration: The signals table refreshes and displays the RTAAA Range Trade signal, which is one of the key setups from the recorded session.
steps.point_out: A table row appears with RTAAA in the symbol column and Range Trade as the setup type.

steps.title: Open Range Trade signal detail panel
steps.narration: We click the RTAAA Range Trade row to open its detail panel and see the full geometry information.
steps.point_out: The detail panel expands below the table, showing the signal's header with trigger price, entry, and invalidation level.

steps.title: Range Trade geometry line with disclosure fields
steps.narration: The detail panel shows the geometry line describing the range setup: its width in MBR, zone touches, break slot, and whether the price crossed the midrange. This iteration adds a new optional disclosure field for whether the approach swing turned at midrange.
steps.point_out: The geometry line reads exactly: 'range 5.00 MBR wide · low zone touches 2 · high zone touches 2 · broke at slot 7 · crossed midrange'. The new field is present but false for this signal, so the 'turned at midrange' text does not appear—exactly as expected.

steps.title: All Desk sections remain intact and error-free
steps.narration: Scrolling through the full Desk page confirms that all sections—Top-up Runs, Index Reconciliation, Screen Runs, Playbook Signals, Backscan, and Playbook Evidence—are present and working correctly. No new errors were introduced by this iteration's disclosure field.
steps.point_out: All six section headings are visible in order from top to bottom with no error banners or broken layouts. The Backscan section shows a completed run from 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24, and the Evidence section displays the full distribution table.
